claim_one_line: THE GOLDEN SPECTRUM ON THE TICK'S GEODESIC (sealed; PROVED): on the principle's own closed geodesic (the axis of LR, through i) the weave's lowest symmetric coupling has the tau-independent masses 1 : phi^-1 : phi^-2 (66 points, 3e-15), and on no other closed geodesic or reflection line tested and for no other coupling tested (spreads 0.12-0.47); every off-diagonal coupling obeys m1 = m2 + m3 (a theorem); post seal: the coupling is the three theta constants placed off-diagonal (Y_jk proportional to theta_l^2), its spectrum a function of F = sum_p |theta_p/eta|^4 alone (Jacobi's theta2 theta3 theta4 = 2 eta^3), golden exactly at F = 8, and the level set F = 8 is, to 1e-9 on 84 of 88 sampled points (the rest at crossings), the union of the geodesics of discriminant 5 -- a conjecture until proved. 0 of 19.
